This is a placeholder Privacy Policy. Please have a qualified legal professional review and finalize this document before publishing.

1. Information We Collect

GHLS Inc. ("we," "us," or "our") collects information you provide directly to us when you submit a quote request, contact us through our website, or communicate with us by phone, email, or fax. This may include:

  • Your name and job title
  • Clinic or organization name
  • Email address and phone number
  • Mailing address
  • Information about products you are interested in or have ordered
  • Any other information you choose to provide

We also collect certain information automatically when you visit our website, including your IP address, browser type, referring URLs, and pages visited. This information is collected through standard server logs and analytics tools.

2. How We Use Your Information

We use the information we collect to:

  • Respond to your quote requests and inquiries
  • Process and fulfill orders
  • Communicate with you about your account, orders, or questions
  • Improve our website and services
  • Comply with legal obligations

We do not sell your personal information to third parties for marketing purposes.

3. Sharing of Information

We may share your information with third parties only in the following circumstances:

  • Service providers: We may share information with vendors who assist us in operating our website, processing orders, or communicating with you (e.g., email delivery, form processing services). These providers are bound by confidentiality obligations.
  • Legal compliance: We may disclose information when required by law, subpoena, or other legal process, or when we believe disclosure is necessary to protect our rights or the rights of others.
  • Business transfers: In the event of a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets, your information may be transferred as part of that transaction.

4. Cookies & Tracking

Our website may use cookies and similar tracking technologies to improve your browsing experience and analyze site usage. You can control cookie settings through your browser preferences. Disabling cookies may affect the functionality of certain parts of the site.

We may use third-party analytics tools (such as Google Analytics) that collect anonymized usage data. These tools are subject to their own privacy policies.

5. Security

We implement reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect the information we collect from unauthorized access, disclosure, or destruction. However, no data transmission or storage system is completely secure. We cannot guarantee the absolute security of your information.

6. Your Rights

Depending on your location, you may have certain rights regarding your personal information, including the right to access, correct, or delete the information we hold about you. To exercise any of these rights, please contact us using the information below.

7. Contact Us

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact us at:
